rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_constrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.73979, n_angles=2304, n_det=736, det_spacing=1.285044, sod=595.362, sdd=1086.803, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.05, train_n=400, val_n=214, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.5, fd_recon_eta=0.3, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=mayo_ldct_2d, rationale=iter-5 EXPLORATORY, last orthogonal lever: eta 1.0->0.3 from iter-4 base (best PSNR 32.245, init_t=0.5, full DC dc_relax=1.0, 8 steps). Six-box read: NFE (8->16:+1.19dB->32.22), DC (dc_relax 0.5->1.0: no gain), init_t (0.7->0.5: +0.28dB recovered DC loss) all mapped; ceiling pinned ~32.25dB, ~1.84dB UNDER the 34.08 LD-FBP floor so hr=0 across all four iters. Hypothesis: residual gap is the few-step flow prior over-denoising the high-PSNR FBP via stochastic drift; lower eta reduces sampler stochasticity, keeping the trajectory nearer the DC-anchored FBP estimate to claw back PSNR. If eta=0.3 does not lift PSNR toward 34.08, the regime-bound ceiling is confirmed and iter-6+ should be empty confirmations toward iter-20. Single knob: eta. Runtime ~400s << 1200s budget.
